description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Notify the Award made to the Industrial Disputes between S. A. S. Bandara and the Finance & Gurantee Company Limited
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of an arbitration award under the Industrial Disputes Act, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. It involves statutory procedures for dispute resolution, references to specific legislation (Industrial Disputes Act Chapter 131), and the formal publication of a legal decision. While it mentions government officials like the Commissioner General of Labour and the Minister of Labour, these references are in the context of their statutory roles in the legal process rather than personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The core content is about legal proceedings and regulatory compliance, making it Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory).
